what: When a link to another page of the same site is clicked, the body panel first sinks 14px (.2s power2.out), then slides up out of view by 14% of the screen height (max 140px, .4s power3.in), and from .16s into that it fades out over .22s before navigating. The arriving page waits .32s covered by a background-color curtain, and while the curtain lifts over .2s power2.out, the body rises from 156px below and transparent over .78s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)

options.hold: Wait (s) after arrival before the curtain lifts, default .32
options.rise: Distance (px) the body rises on arrival, default 156
options.lift: Upper limit (px) of the distance it exits upward when leaving, default 140 (the smaller of that and 14% of the screen)
options.wait: Wait before leaving (sec), default 0 — for closing the drawer first
options.cover: (optional) selector of the background-color curtain that covers and then lifts on arrival — keep it outside the panel (if the panel moves, fixed elements inside it get pushed too)
options.fx:leave: Event the panel emits when it starts to leave

from.where: index.html·contact.html .ps-view — original PageTransitionProvider (leave y 14 → −min(14vh,140) · on arrival enterCover lifts after .32s · body y 156 → 0 in .78s with the page-enter curve)
